role: Stricter SwiftLint config (parent .swiftlint.yml) with lower thresholds, intended for linting changed files only.
toplevel: parent_config .swiftlint.yml; overrides line_length 150/250, function_body_length 80/150, function_parameter_count 6/8, type_body_length 400/700, file_length 800/1300, cyclomatic_complexity 12/25, large_tuple 3/4, identifier_name min_length 2/2 with '_' allowed. Its only consumer is scripts/lint_changed_swift.sh:29 (`swiftlint lint --strict --config .swiftlint-strict.yml --use-script-input-files`), and that script is not invoked by any Makefile target, .githooks/pre-commit or .github workflow (grep finds only docs/MAINTAINERS.md:346 listing the file).

flags.text: The strict config is reachable only through scripts/lint_changed_swift.sh, which nothing in Makefile, .githooks or .github/workflows calls; the stricter thresholds never gate anything.
